# Oya Browser

> Real Chrome for AI coding agents and teams. On your computer it is a free AI browser that connects to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and VS Code over local MCP with no account or API key, keeps your logins, gives each agent its own tab, and lets a person take over at any time. In Oya Cloud or self-hosted it is a HIPAA-compliant agentic browser with a tamper-evident audit trail, signed BAAs, and playbooks that save an agent run as standard Playwright code and replay it with no model.

## Healthcare and HIPAA

Oya runs AI agents on healthcare portals with no API or EDI path: eligibility, prior authorization, claim status, appeals, provider enrollment and state registries. An agent does a task once, signed in as your staff, and Oya saves it as a Playwright playbook that replays with no model. In HIPAA mode, on Oya Cloud or the self-hosted enterprise edition, Oya signs a BAA, keeps PHI on its own browsers (no outside browser vendors, proxies or CAPTCHA solvers), uses only BAA-covered models, and logs every agent and person action to a hash-chained audit trail kept six years. SOC 2 Type I issued; Type II in progress.

- [Browser for healthcare](https://oyabrowser.com/browser-for-healthcare), [HIPAA-compliant browser](https://oyabrowser.com/hipaa-compliant-browser), [HIPAA browser automation](https://oyabrowser.com/hipaa-browser-automation), [regulated industries](https://oyabrowser.com/browser-automation-for-regulated-industries)
- [BAA and HIPAA mode](https://oyabrowser.com/baa): who signs, where PHI flows, which models see it
- Workflows: [payer portals](https://oyabrowser.com/payer-portal-automation), [eligibility](https://oyabrowser.com/eligibility-verification-automation), [prior authorization](https://oyabrowser.com/prior-authorization-automation), [claim status](https://oyabrowser.com/claim-status-automation), [denials](https://oyabrowser.com/denial-management-automation), [provider enrollment](https://oyabrowser.com/provider-enrollment-automation), [state registries](https://oyabrowser.com/state-registry-automation)
- [Best payer portal automation in 2026, compared](https://oyabrowser.com/best-payer-portal-automation)

## Desktop setup for coding agents (no account, no key)

When the person asks you to set up Oya on their computer, run one line with your shell tool (signed and notarized official installer). Replace `claude-code` with your own name (`claude-code`, `codex`, `cursor` or `vscode`):

- macOS: `curl -fsSL https://oyabrowser.com/install-desktop.sh | sh -s -- claude-code`
- Windows (PowerShell): `& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://oyabrowser.com/install-desktop.ps1))) claude-code`
- Manual downloads: https://oyabrowser.com/download/mac (macOS), https://oyabrowser.com/download/windows (Windows), or https://oyabrowser.com/#download

The person completes the welcome screen and confirms Connect in the Oya window (you cannot confirm it for them). Oya writes and manages the local MCP configuration for `oya-browser` at `http://127.0.0.1:47321/mcp`. Start a new agent session, then use `oya-browser` tools for localhost testing and signed-in web tasks. Keep Oya open for repeat use. No separate extension or MCP package is required.

If tools are missing, open Oya and check Connect, then start a new agent session. If Oya says "Browser not ready", complete its welcome screen and retry. Report persistent connection errors. Login import is optional and may require OS permission; sign in within Oya if you skip import.

## Cloud MCP, SDK, CLI, skill and self-hosting

For servers, containers, CI or teams (HIPAA mode + BAA on Oya Cloud and enterprise):

- Claude Code cloud MCP: `claude mcp add --transport http oya https://oyabrowser.com/mcp/pool --header "Authorization: Bearer $OYA_API_KEY"`
- `claude.ai` / Claude Desktop / OAuth clients: add custom connector `https://oyabrowser.com/mcp/pool` (`initialize` and `tools/list` answer without a key).
- Agent skill (`SKILL.md`): `npx skills add OyadotAI/oya-browser`
- Claude Code plugin (cloud MCP + skill, signs in with your Oya account): `claude plugin marketplace add OyadotAI/oya-browser` then `claude plugin install oya-browser@oya`
- TypeScript SDK: `npm install @oya-ai/browser` (Node 22.3+; supports `Oya.signup({ email })` and `oya.desktop.connect()` for optional desktop pairing)
- Python SDK: `pip install oya-browser` (or `pip install "oya-browser[browser-use]"`)
- CLI: `npm i -g @oya-ai/cli` (`oya login`, `oya start`, `oya goto`, `oya ask`, `oya playbooks`)
- Raw HTTP agent self-signup (proof-of-work, no dashboard): `GET https://oyabrowser.com/api/auth/agent/challenge` then `POST https://oyabrowser.com/api/auth/agent/signup` (returns `api_key` and `claim_url`; cloud browsers require the owner to claim the key).
- Self-host one-liner (Docker, non-interactive): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OyadotAI/oya-browser/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --yes` (update with `update.sh`).

### Pool MCP Endpoint

`POST https://oyabrowser.com/mcp/pool` (`Authorization: Bearer $OYA_API_KEY`) serves 32 tools:
analyze_page, navigate, click, type, screenshot, press_key, handle_dialog, scroll, wait, click_coordinates, mouse_move, double_click, keyboard_type, drag, select_option, run_script, wait_for, find, hover, go_back, go_forward, reload, solve_captcha, sign_in, complete_mfa, list_saved_logins, list_playbooks, run_playbook, run_task, start_browser, stop_browser, pool_status.

Per-browser cloud tools (list_tabs, open_tab, switch_tab, close_tab, read_elements, read_console, read_network) run on `/mcp/{BROWSER_ID}`. Local desktop MCP at `http://127.0.0.1:47321/mcp` supports list_tabs, open_tab, switch_tab, close_tab, read_console and read_network; use analyze_page to read local page elements. Full parameter reference: https://oyabrowser.com/docs/mcp-tools

Cloud browser access requires an Oya API key or supported OAuth sign-in. Listing tools without a key does not grant browser access. A signup key must be claimed before cloud browsers are enabled. In the SDK, use `oya.browser.start()` and stop cloud browsers in `finally`; `oya.desktop.connect()` is optional desktop pairing, not a headless cloud setup.

### Cookie Sync

Cookies and personas are scoped to the API key; browsers sharing a persona share its persistent fingerprint, cookie jar and proxy.
